name: refs
description: Tracks the reference codes (F1, D2, A3) Claude defines: a /refs pane, and cited codes resolved for the model

findings.title: F codes
findings.description: The group's name, a colon, then up to three answers in order: go, stop, later.

decisions.title: D codes
decisions.description: The group's name, a colon, then up to three answers in order: go, stop, later.

options.title: O codes
options.description: The group's name, a colon, then up to three answers in order: go, stop, later. One option per reply can hold the first answer.

risks.title: R codes
risks.description: The group's name, a colon, then up to three answers in order: go, stop, later.

questions.title: Q codes
questions.description: The group's name, a colon, then up to three answers in order: go, stop, later.

actions.title: A codes
actions.description: The group's name, a colon, then up to three answers in order: go, stop, later.

otherKinds.title: Other letters
otherKinds.description: Name the letters Claude makes up, separated by semicolons, e.g. E=Events: keep, drop, later; M=Mods: build, skip, later. A letter not named here is named after the heading above it in the reply.

otherAnswers.title: Answers for other letters
otherAnswers.description: Up to three answers for letters not named above, in order: go, stop, later.

vimKeys.title: Vim keys
vimKeys.description: Letter keys in the Refs pane (j/k move, y/n/d answer, i type, b btw, z fold) and /refs taking the keyboard when it opens. Off for now.
